answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and links equivocation evidence across the network: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, aggregate penalties grow quadratically, O(k^2), through cross-identity slashing rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to swarm capital loss, making coordination uneconomic; delta updates preserve auditability, ferrous attestations anchor provenance, and mesa-style escrow isolation limits contagion.
